notes: The loop runs on the owner's Windows machine (Node 26). Main passes the full local suite after every group of merges: typecheck, lint, 2,757 tests with coverage, fallow, docs snippets and the four Agent Forge checks.

ai v7 support is one ticket from done. Runtime, types, tests and the Worker bundle all work on ai v4 and v7 (D26, D27, D28a-c). D28d, in flight, widens the published peer ranges. Ollama on ai 7 needs zod 4 (D29).

Breaking changes shipped pre-1.0 (all in CHANGELOG with migration notes): sandboxed commands no longer inherit the host environment (X11); CLI commands reject unknown flags (U21); MCP tools without readOnlyHint ask for approval by default; error codes renamed to LOUSHY_*; tool-error results moved the message into message.

Limits left in shipped features, each with a ticket: the credential broker does not route Docker containers yet, so container network allowlists still mean no network (X12.2); any Slack workspace member can click Approve or Deny (P5.2); a remote sub-agent that pauses for approval is reported as an error (Y7.2); the generated node deploy target and loushy dev do not serve an agent directory's schedules and channels yet (P8.2); a crash resume re-resolves dynamic config without the original metadata (V15.2); 66 provider tests run only on ai v4 (D28e).
Branches are never deleted (owner instruction). Merged lou-* branches remain on origin. To save disk, installed dependencies are removed from an agent's worktree after its PR merges.
CI is not awaited (owner instruction). CI pins Node 22; the local runs use Node 26.
Jira: the connected Atlassian site has no LOU project; tickets live in STATE.md.
npm publish is an owner action (D49 prepares it).
